title: A GILT AND MAPLE-WOOD HARP BY SEBASTIAN AND PIERRE ERARD / CIRCA 1830'S
description: A GILT AND MAPLE-WOOD HARP BY SEBASTIAN AND PIERRE ERARD / CIRCA 1830'S / The brass plate with engraved inscription 'Sebastian & Pierre Erard's Patent No. 6539. Great Marlborough Street, London', the upright with applied gilt-gesso Gothic decoration / 71 in. (180 cm.) high / In wood case with a harp maker's label for I.G.Morley and with canvas and linen covers
